title: Lavender Hill (Depsiton Cres, approx.): 2 men shot dead, woman wounded, 6 Oct
summary: Two men were shot dead and a woman wounded in Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill, shortly after 08:00 on Tuesday 6 October; the men were declared dead at the scene and the suspects fled (Southern Mail, quoting ...
story: Two men were shot dead and a woman wounded in Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill, shortly after 08:00 on Tuesday 6 October; the men were declared dead at the scene and the suspects fled (Southern Mail, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg).
location_note: Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill. Muir Court is not on the map, so the pin is Depsiton Crescent.

provenance.note: One report. The police statement, plus the local policing forum chair.

facts.label: Deaths
facts.claim: Two men dead; a woman wounded.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: Twigg said the two men were declared dead at the scene by medical personnel, while the woman was transported to a medical facility for treatment.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: the shooting took place shortly after 8am in Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill.

facts.label: Place
facts.claim: Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill (street level).

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: the shooting took place shortly after 8am in Muir Court, Depsiton Crescent, Lavender Hill.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: upon arrival on the scene they found the victims with gunshot wounds to their bodies

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: The motive for the attack is believed to be gang-related.

facts.label: Legal status
facts.claim: Murder and attempted murder cases; suspects fled, no arrests.

sources.name: Sgt Wesley Twigg, SAPS Western Cape
sources.quote: The suspects fled the scene and are yet to be arrested
